name: task-10
_ambiguities: The resulting order after the drag is not asserted: option texts are random and no op compares order. The comma-separated index value in the param-named control is not asserted because that control's name is the random question name.
Only that the drag completes (elements exist and have size) and that the option count is unchanged is checked.
Whether a removed option is hidden or removed from the DOM is not pinned; only the last remaining row's visibility is checked.
Preview option rows are assumed to be .option elements inside the question root.
Drag uses the replay drag op (synthetic HTML5 DnD events). A real-mouse-only implementation would not be seen as a drag by this op.
